assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road/rail/water/heritage lines, cadastral ownership, existing buildings, municipal systems, fire/security conditions, and approved height/FAR controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No parcel, demolition, construction, engineering, or statutory-control conclusion is made; every spatial move remains conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry inferred from public text and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: Locations, areas, ratios, figures, and PDFs must be recomputed when official or cleared polygons arrive; provisional geometry is never an official redline.

assumptions.statement: The concept does not determine who has a housing, tenancy, ownership, co-residence, agency, visitor, or emergency-entry right.
assumptions.impact: Only an authorised applicable human procedure may confirm, change, or end a housing relationship or entry authority; AI, property operators, landlords, vendors, and the proposal cannot adjudicate it.

assumptions.statement: Path-equivalence, waiting, staffing, night coverage, emergency opening, and recovery targets are tested only with synthetic personas in an unloaded 1:1 prototype.
assumptions.impact: No claim is made about real staffing capacity, waiting time, security, accessibility, fire performance, or service reliability.

assumptions.statement: No real resident, lease, access event, biometric sample, phone number, housing record, institution, or building is used.
assumptions.impact: The package can demonstrate workflow logic but cannot evidence real need, legality, performance, or resident acceptance.

assumptions.statement: Human fallback must not make frontline staff an unlimited backup system.
assumptions.impact: Any real pilot requires staffing caps, cover shifts, escalation, training, safety, exit rights, backlog ordering, and restoration reconciliation agreed with affected workers.
